 A Travel Tip Guide: Thanksgiving Edition
 November 18, 2026 
 Thanksgiving is historically one of the busiest travel periods of the year at America's Friendliest Airport®. We put together a quick step-by-step guide to navigate a busy travel weekend.
 Step One – Reserve a parking spot in advance, as parking fills up quickly at PHX.
 Step Two – Avoid terminal curb congestion by dropping off and picking up at the 24th or 44th Street PHX Sky Train ® stations. The roadways are especially busy around the Thanksgiving holiday. Using the 24 th Street or 44 th Street PHX Sky Train® Stations for pick up and drop-off helps save time and avoid traffic.
 Step Three – Use PHX RESERVE to reserve a time at the TSA Security Checkpoint screening area, available in both terminals.
 Step Four – Plan ahead by being REAL ID ready, read TSA’s “ What Can I Bring Page? ,” and arrive at least two hours before the scheduled flight departure for domestic flights and three hours for international travel.
 Step Five – Check the flight status with your airline, the TSA wait times at skyharbor.com , and for any roadway restrictions on our website before leaving.
 Step Six – If you’re picking someone up, wait at one of our three Cell Phone Waiting Lots instead of circling the terminals.
 Lastly, once at the airport, make sure to check out Early Bag Check , feel free to ask our friendly Navigators a question, or take some time to check out our Phoenix Airport Museum .
